Acceptance criteria: - render_summary(s, 'json') parses back to s - --format json is accepted on the command line - md output unchanged Current check results (before any change): all checks pass Notes: - files that look relevant: report.py, render.py, stats.py Repository outline: report.py (25 lines) — Command line: summarize the numeric columns of a CSV file. def render_summary(summary: dict, fmt: str) -> str def main(argv: list[str] | None=None) -> None render.py (15 lines) — Turn a summary into Markdown or HTML. def to_markdown(summary: dict[str, dict[str, float]]) -> str def to_html(summary: dict[str, dict[str, float]]) -> str stats.py (30 lines) — Column statistics for CSV files. def load(path: Path) -> list[dict[str, str]] def median(values: list[float]) -> float def summarize(rows: list[dict[str, str]]) -> dict[str, dict[str, float]] README.md (4 lines) << str: if fmt == "md": return render.to_markdown(summary) return render.to_html(summary) def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> None: parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Summarize the numeric columns of a CSV file.") parser.add_argument("--input", required=True, type=Path) parser.add_argument("--format", choices=["md", "html"], default="md") args = parser.parse_args(argv) print(render_summary(stats.summarize(stats.load(args.input)), args.format), end="") if __name__ == "__main__": main() FILE>>> << str: lines = ["| column | min | max | mean | median |", "|---|---|---|---|---|"] for column, s in summary.items(): lines.append(f"| {column} | {s['min']:g} | {s['max']:g} | {s['mean']:.2f} | {s['median']:g} |") return "\n".join(lines) + "\n" def to_html(summary: dict[str, dict[str, float]]) -> str: rows = "".join(f"{html.escape(c)}{s['mean']:.2f}" for c, s in summary.items()) return f"{rows}
